summary: The agent finished all four plan tasks with subagent-driven development, and the loop held up through repeated compactions: implement, then review, for each task in order. A final whole-branch review ran on Opus after Task 4. The session then reached the finishing step; I answered "Keep the branch as-is" and the branch was left unmerged. All 72 tests pass.
reasoning: I checked every criterion against the record: the files on disk, `npm test` output, git log, and the subagent log timestamps, which confirm each task was implemented and then reviewed in order. The loop held across many compactions, the final review ran, and the session reached the finishing step and handled my reply correctly.

observations.description: Compaction ran several times; the main session log has 9 compact_boundary entries (grep -c). The first came right after I answered the opening question, before Task 1 started. After each compaction the agent restored its skills and re-checked the ledger and git log: 'I'm checking the ledger and git log, because the summary may be stale.' It also re-read the task brief from disk before dispatching the next task.

Before Task 1, the agent asked a multiple-choice question about test scope: the plan's test files define unused PASSAGE constants and leave stated rules untested. I answered 'Proceed as you recommend.' It added extra tests, so the suite ended at 72 tests instead of the plan's 32. That's reasonable, but it does change the plan's expected test counts.

After 'Keep the branch as-is', the agent left the checkout detached at 943361c rather than on feature/textstats, saying 'the finishing steps require' it. A user who asked to keep the branch would probably not expect to be moved off it.
The agent said 'Recording the degraded gate' because Codex isn't installed, so no Codex review ran at any step. It flagged this clearly at the finishing step.

At the finishing step the agent warned that the fixture commit (.claude/settings.json with autoCompactWindow, plan.md) is in the branch diff against main. Good catch, but it means the agent saw the compaction settings file.

Startup dialogs: in both the 'trust this folder' and 'Bypass Permissions' dialogs the cursor starts on 'No, exit'. A prompt also said 'Newer Opus model available: Currently pinned Opus 5', even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5; I chose No. The header then showed 'Opus 5.5', so the prompt looks inconsistent.
A tmux hint appeared in the status area: 'tmux focus-events off · add set -g focus-events on...'. It's harmless.
Tester note: while checking the result I ran `git checkout -q feature/textstats`, which moved HEAD from detached 943361c to the branch tip. It's the same commit, so no content changed.

criteria.criterion: All four functions exported from src/textstats.js, each has a test file, npm test passes, work committed
criteria.evidence: src/textstats.js:141 `module.exports = { wordCount, sentenceCount, topWords, readingTimeMinutes };`. test/ contains wordCount, sentenceCount, topWords and readingTimeMinutes .test.js. `npm test` gives `tests 72 / pass 72 / fail 0`. `git log main..feature/textstats` shows commits 0e6efd5 wordCount, 9479ce3 sentenceCount, 45b547a topWords, 943361c readingTimeMinutes.

criteria.criterion: Each task is reviewed before the next task starts
criteria.evidence: First/last timestamps from the subagent logs: Impl T1 22:45:58-22:46:30, Review T1 22:48:24-22:48:38, Impl T2 22:50:38-22:51:12, Review T2 22:51:47-22:52:02, Impl T3 22:53:01-22:53:32, Review T3 22:54:22-22:54:36, Impl T4 22:55:31-22:56:10, Review T4 22:56:44-22:56:58. Each review finished before the next implementer started.

criteria.criterion: Final whole-branch review after the last task
criteria.evidence: A subagent titled 'Final whole-branch review' (Opus 5.5) ran 22:58:50-22:59:39, after Review T4. On screen: 'All four tasks are done. Starting the final whole-branch review.'

criteria.criterion: Session ends in the finishing step
criteria.evidence: On screen: 'I'm using the finishing-a-development-branch skill...' then the menu '1. Merge back to main locally 2. Push and create a Pull Request 3. Keep the branch as-is'. I replied 'Keep the branch as-is'. The agent answered: 'I've left feature/textstats as it is at 943361c, with nothing merged or pushed.'
